import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MOD = 1000000007;

    static int qpow(int base, int exp) {
        int result = 1;
        int b = base;
        int e = exp;
        while (e > 0) {
            if ((e & 1) == 1) {
                result = (int) ((long) result * b % MOD);
            }
            b = (int) ((long) b * b % MOD);
            e >>= 1;
        }
        return result;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st;

        int n = Integer.parseInt(br.readLine());
        int[][] p = new int[10][10];

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                int per = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
                p[i][j] = (int) ((long) per * qpow(100, MOD - 2) % MOD);
            }
        }
        for (int i = n; i < 6; i++) {
            p[i][i] = 1;
        }

        List<Integer> combs = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < (1 << 6); i++) {
            int count = 0;
            for (int j = 0; j < 6; j++) {
                if (((i >> j) & 1) == 1) count++;
            }
            if (count == 3) {
                combs.add(i);
            }
        }

        int sizeF = 1 << 18;
        int sizeG = 1 << 20;
        int[] f = new int[sizeF];
        int[] g = new int[sizeG];

        // First block
        for (int i = 0; i < sizeF; i++) {
            boolean[][] b = new boolean[6][6];
            int tmp = 0;
            int mask = 0;
            int prob = 1;
            for (int j = 0; j <= 5; j++) {
                for (int k = 0; k <= 2; k++) {
                    if (((i >> tmp) & 1) == 1) {
                        b[j][k] = true;
                        prob = (int) ((long) prob * p[j][k] % MOD);
                    } else {
                        prob = (int) ((long) prob * (MOD + 1 - p[j][k]) % MOD);
                    }
                    tmp++;
                }
            }
            for (int j = 0; j < 20; j++) {
                int[] p_list = new int[3];
                int p_count = 0;
                for (int k = 0; k <= 5; k++) {
                    if (((combs.get(j) >> k) & 1) == 1) {
                        p_list[p_count++] = k;
                    }
                }
                int p1 = p_list[0], p2 = p_list[1], p3 = p_list[2];
                if ((b[p1][0] && b[p2][1] && b[p3][2]) ||
                    (b[p1][0] && b[p2][2] && b[p3][1]) ||
                    (b[p1][1] && b[p2][0] && b[p3][2]) ||
                    (b[p1][1] && b[p2][2] && b[p3][0]) ||
                    (b[p1][2] && b[p2][0] && b[p3][1]) ||
                    (b[p1][2] && b[p2][1] && b[p3][0])) {
                    mask |= 1 << j;
                }
            }
            f[mask] = (f[mask] + prob) % MOD;
        }

        // Second block
        for (int i = 0; i < sizeF; i++) {
            boolean[][] b = new boolean[6][6];
            int tmp = 0;
            int mask = 0;
            int prob = 1;
            for (int j = 0; j <= 5; j++) {
                for (int k = 3; k <= 5; k++) {
                    if (((i >> tmp) & 1) == 1) {
                        b[j][k] = true;
                        prob = (int) ((long) prob * p[j][k] % MOD);
                    } else {
                        prob = (int) ((long) prob * (MOD + 1 - p[j][k]) % MOD);
                    }
                    tmp++;
                }
            }
            for (int j = 0; j < 20; j++) {
                int[] p_list = new int[3];
                int p_count = 0;
                int s = combs.get(j) ^ 63; // XOR with 63
                for (int k = 0; k <= 5; k++) {
                    if (((s >> k) & 1) == 1) {
                        p_list[p_count++] = k;
                    }
                }
                int p1 = p_list[0], p2 = p_list[1], p3 = p_list[2];
                if ((b[p1][3] && b[p2][4] && b[p3][5]) ||
                    (b[p1][3] && b[p2][5] && b[p3][4]) ||
                    (b[p1][4] && b[p2][3] && b[p3][5]) ||
                    (b[p1][4] && b[p2][5] && b[p3][3]) ||
                    (b[p1][5] && b[p2][3] && b[p3][4]) ||
                    (b[p1][5] && b[p2][4] && b[p3][3])) {
                    mask |= 1 << j;
                }
            }
            g[mask] = (g[mask] + prob) % MOD;
        }

        // Fast Walsh–Hadamard transform for g
        for (int i = 0; i < 20; i++) {
            for (int j = sizeG - 1; j >= 0; j--) {
                if (((j >> i) & 1) == 1) {
                    g[j] = (g[j] + g[j ^ (1 << i)]) % MOD;
                }
            }
        }

        long answer = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < sizeF; i++) {
            answer = (answer + (long) f[i] * g[(sizeG - 1) ^ i] % MOD) % MOD;
        }

        System.out.println((int) ((MOD + 1 - answer) % MOD));
    }
}
